label: Format Field
description: Format values in a selected field.

options.label: eight digits with leading zeroes
options.description: Pad the value to eight digits.

options.label: date format MM/DD/YYYY
options.description: Show the value as a date.

options.label: number
options.description: Keep the value as a number.

default.excel: {{#switch (formatKind param.format)}}{{#case "digits"}}TEXT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (repeat "0" (formatDigits param.format))}}){{/case}}{{#case "date"}}TEXT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, "mm/dd/yyyy"){{/case}}{{#case "number"}}VALUE({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}){{/case}}{{#case "text"}}TEXT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, "@"){{/case}}{{#default}}TEXT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (trim (default param.format "text"))}}){{/default}}{{/switch}}
default.sql: {{#switch (formatKind param.format)}}{{#case "digits"}}RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', {{formatDigits param.format}}) + CAST({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}} AS VARCHAR(50)), {{formatDigits param.format}}){{/case}}{{#case "date"}}CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), TRY_CONVERT(date, {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}), 101){{/case}}{{#case "number"}}TRY_CAST({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}} AS DECIMAL(38, 10)){{/case}}{{#case "text"}}CAST({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}} AS NVARCHAR(4000)){{/case}}{{#default}}FORMAT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (trim (default param.format "text"))}}){{/default}}{{/switch}}
default.python: {{#switch (formatKind param.format)}}{{#case "digits"}}{{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}.astype("string").str.zfill({{formatDigits param.format}}){{/case}}{{#case "date"}}pd.to_datetime({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, errors="coerce").dt.strftime("%m/%d/%Y"){{/case}}{{#case "number"}}pd.to_numeric({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, errors="coerce"){{/case}}{{#default}}{{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}.astype("string"){{/default}}{{/switch}}

notes: {{#if (eq (formatKind param.format) "custom")}}Note: Format "{{trim (default param.format "text")}}" is not a standard option. Check the formulas before running.{{/if}}

outcomes.atlas: {{tableColumn param.source_file param.source_alias param.field_name}} displays in {{default param.format "the designed"}} format.
outcomes.source: The formatted {{tableColumn param.source_file param.source_alias param.field_name}} value matches the underlying source value.
